decisions.reason: Because it remained on the website after the first post-launch review, management would read it as at least meeting a tolerable aspiration level in a complementary coolant niche and keep it unless 2025 orders disappoint clearly.

The centrifuge has survived the initial pruning, but as a more specialised and likely narrower-demand product it sits closer to the aspiration threshold, so it is kept with somewhat higher risk of withdrawal if performance stays below comparable offers.

Its continued presence while another conveyor variant was already removed suggests this scraper belt model fits the firm’s core mechanical handling business and is performing acceptably relative to aspirations, so management would keep it.

The hinged belt conveyor appears to have cleared the early review stage and, with organisational slack in a large established machinery firm, would typically be retained as a core variant unless new evidence shows persistent underperformance.
